# Developer Workflow

Receive Task
↓
Understand requirements
↓
Need clarification?
 ├─ Yes → Ask questions
 └─ No
↓
Search repository
↓
Found similar implementation?
 ├─ Yes → Reuse pattern
 └─ No → Design new solution
↓
Identify affected layers
↓
Implement smallest correct change
↓
Add validation
↓
Add logging
↓
Write/update tests
↓
Run self review
↓
Done
